bounded_decision: Native scoped IDs, ranks and BM25 scores match the independent full-index oracle throughout the executed matrix.
Dense/common-term current CTE JOIN shape is materially costly:10k/all/dense/K100 about14.7s versus exact pipeline about0.39s.
Recorded scored-table scan plus eligible-size scaling is consistent with repeated scanning in this query shape; optimizer root cause is not proven.
Do not infer universally slow FTS: standalone direct BM25 bridge request components are about41/43ms in the same dense pair, and source1 candidate pipelines are about18ms.

Retain original raw-JOIN/schema failures; no larger runs, post-hoc threshold changes, backend/default switching or final adoption claim. One separately authorized single-point CROSS JOIN diagnostic may follow and must not replace this initial matrix.
limitations: Chunk branch only; summary aggregation and cross-scope corpus perturbation NOT_RUN.
Actual relational key/current-root/local-S2 checks do not exercise the public service or full Learning closure.
Read LIMIT513 limits guard output, not engine CPU/memory. Fixed 10k fixture and subprocess deadlines are separate limits.
Global BM25 relevance policy is still unselected. Historical raw-JOIN zero-score failure is retained.
Two paired observations per cell are descriptive; no latency SLO, production speedup or hardware acceptance.
